appearances.snippet: So I wondered if the girl had given him stuff, like if there is an accomplice.

verification.notes: Verified as an attribution claim. At 690.8 seconds, an embedded clip introduced as Skyler Broderick’s aunt contains this exact speculative question. The speaker is not asserting that an accomplice existed; she hedges with “wondered” and “if” and raises a possibility. This true result confirms only that the aunt made the quoted speculation. It does not verify that the girl supplied items or was an accomplice. The episode is the primary audiovisual source. The earlier legacy mixed assessment remains preserved in legacy_claim_provenance.
